# Attribution and rights: SHIP-DETAIL-02

**Authorship.** This is original procedural work, made with AI (Claude Opus 5.5) for Apoliak7777's OUT OF REACH team on 15 November 2026.

**Geometry.** All of it is generated by the scripts in `Source/` on top of the team's own AURORA-7 generator in `../Source` (`a7kit.py`, `a7_ship.py`). No third-party models, scans, photographs, downloaded assets, paid assets or AI-generated images are used, and no new packages are added.

**Materials and textures.** None are new. Every material slot reuses an existing AURORA-7 (`A7_*`) material asset by name:
- these assets and their textures come from the team's `a7_textures.py`;
- the labels come from the existing `A7_Decals` atlas.

**Text and insignia.** All visible text is fictional AURORA-7 ship labelling from that atlas: cautions, connector numbers, part numbers, barcodes and fastener notes. No NASA, ESA or other agency logo or mark is used.

**Design references.** These are general engineering practice for proportions and function only; nothing is copied:
- cushioned P-clamps on standoffs;
- circular connectors with backshells and strain-relief boots;
- quarter-turn fasteners;
- barrel hinges;
- gasketed access panels.

**Licence.** The package is the team's own work and may be used in the game and its showcase under the project's terms.
